summary: FiscalNote Holdings filed an 8-K disclosing a waiver agreement with noteholder GPO FN Noteholder, LLC to defer a $2.0M quarterly principal payment on a 7.50% Senior Subordinated Convertible Promissory Note due 2029. The company is evaluating strategic options, including renegotiating debt with senior and subordinated lenders, and has engaged an external financial advisor. Discussions may involve amendments, maturity extensions, liability management transactions, and exchanges. No specific price, premium, or close date; no board recommendation or deal advisors named. No assurance of any outcome. Watch for potential liability management or exchange offers as debt restructuring continues.
